comparison.objective: Close a flowing-line valve gradually to avoid water hammer; candidate tunes damping through repeated guarded cycles.
comparison.physical_skill: Timed staged valve rotation versus hex-key engagement, setscrew manipulation, fine collar adjustment, counterholding, and physical cycle actuation.
comparison.success_condition: Valve reaches shut stop with at least four seconds between marks versus two repeatable stops within stroke, rebound, overload, and drift limits.
comparison.reason: Both concern safe control of dynamic effects, but the tested manipulation and feedback loop are materially different: prescribed staged closure versus iterative parameter commissioning and locking.
